title: sdr daily scratchpad - isabel cho - 2026-03-04
content:
TODAY (2026-03-04) - quick plan / running log

Morning north star: 6 connects (calls + demos), 10 follow-up emails, move 3 opps to MQL/SQL. Focus on Mid-market prospects that requested pricing last week.

Top priority call list (start w/ warmest)
1) SyncroHealth (CMO: Priya Shah) - 9:30am PST - recent trial usage spike, ask about inference latency pain + Dedicated interest. Prep: notes from last convo (trial started 2/20, saw 3x token volume). Goal: qualify budget + timeline.
2) BrightBank - 11:00am PST - AE previously demoed; follow-up on compliance questions (KMS/HSM). Ask: on-prem vs VPC? Slack: @leah had thread with engineering answers.
3) NovaRetail (CTO: Marcus Li) - 2:00pm PST - potential pilot for recommendation rerank. Quick ask: sample traffic and SLA needs.
4) Verity Labs - 3:30pm PST - discovery call (new). Goal: intro + book deeper tech call.

Follow-ups to send (email templates below)
- Hothouse / pricing follow-up: send tailored price range + sample throughput estimate. Include link to dedicated docs.
- BrightBank compliance recap: dd + KMS bullets + attach SOC2 summary.
- SyncroHealth data question: ask for typical prompt length + peak concurrent requests so I can recommend batching/quantization.

Pipeline notes (quick bullets)
- SyncroHealth: P0. Token volumes ramp. Decision maker: Priya + infra lead (TBD). Next: 2nd call to include engineering.
- BrightBank: P1. Compliance heavy -> Private/VPC likely. Budget talk next week.
- NovaRetail: P2. Pilot req: 3 weeks, low volume. Could be good reference.
- MidwestCare: cold -> left voicemail 3/2; next touch 3/6.

Meeting prep / tech checks
- Share screen checklist: confirm model latency demo script (short prompts + 1 long prompt), enable streaming, demo live KV cache saving.
- Notes for Priya: mention fallback models + model variants to preserve availability.

Quick email scripts (short)
- Quick follow-up (pricing):
Subject: Quick pricing/throughput for Redwood Dedicated
Hi Priya,
Thanks again for the chat today - attaching a quick estimate for Dedicated capacity based on the traffic you mentioned. Short summary: expected 95th pct latency ~120ms/token for gen-1 model at 8k context, estimated monthly cost $X–$Y depending on sustained vs burst. Happy to get engineering on a call to dive into KV caching and batching to lower costs.
- Isabel

- Compliance recap (BrightBank): attach SOC2 link + short KMS note:
Subject: KMS + SOC2 summary
Leah / team - per our call, attaching SOC2 report and a short note on KMS/HSM integration steps. Happy to set a security review with our SRE.

To-dos (today)
- [ ] Prep demo env for 9:30 (SyncroHealth) - upload sample prompts + enable streaming flag
- [ ] Send pricing email to Priya after call (include rough throughput numbers)
- [ ] Send SOC2 + KMS note to BrightBank by EOD
- [ ] Log call notes in Salesforce + move SyncroHealth to "Demo Scheduled" stage
- [ ] Reach out to MidwestCare on 3/6 (voicemail follow-up)

- This week: 3 demos booked, 2 pilots scoped.

Random / notes to self

- Check with Solutions Eng on demo GPU allocation for live pilot (cc: Samir).
- Remember to mention Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching in demo (saves ~30% tokens).
